properties.name: Proposed Mary Ellis Burial Site P&R / Mary Ellis vicinity
properties.note: Illustrative pickup on the mapped rear service road, outside the Mary Ellis burial plot. Not an existing or approved P&R. Final bay, coach circulation, parking area, owner agreement and cemetery protection require study.

properties.name: Proposed Molly Pitcher Service Area P&R
properties.note: Molly Pitcher is a southbound service area. This concept assumes authorization to open the gated rear service-road connection to Half Acre Road; it is not existing public access. Buses use local roads and enter the Turnpike northbound at Exit 8. P&R use, coach access, gate/security changes and parking capacity are unapproved. The point is an illustrative pickup near the rear access, not an approved boarding bay.
